_metadata.description: SAMPLE configuration for fm.py — copy to fmConfig.json and edit. Shows the logZip API settings plus example syncProfiles and monitorProfiles entries.

_help.howToUse: Copy this file to fmConfig.json (same folder as fm.py), then replace the sample values with your own. Keys starting with _ are documentation only and are ignored by fm.py.
_help.logZip: Used by Zip → Log Zip File. apiUrl points at the DocInfo Manager API endpoint; serverSecretKey authenticates the call — never commit a real key to a public repo.
_help.syncProfiles: Each entry appears as an option on the Sync menu and can run via: fm.py sync --profile NAME. Fields: name (menu label), folderA / folderB (~ is expanded), direction (AtoB or BtoA), recursive (true/false, default true), conflict (newest or largest — which side wins when a file exists on both sides; default newest), excludeHidden (true/false, default true). Sync always previews as a DRY RUN and only copies after you confirm; nothing is ever deleted.
_help.monitorProfiles: Each entry appears as an option on the Monitor menu and can run via: fm.py monitor --profile NAME. Fields: name (menu label), folder (~ is expanded), recursive (true/false, default true), extensions (comma-separated string like "jpg,png" or a list — blank/omitted watches all files), output (log = ~/Documents/log/fm.log, csv = ~/Documents/log/fmMonitor.csv; default log). Monitoring runs until you press Q/ESC.
